**Validate frontmatter shape before appending a comment.**

`append-comment!` parses the task but never calls `law-frontmatter/assert-task-frontmatter-shape`. A present non-string `title`, `priority`, or `status` therefore reaches `inject-write-id`, the file write, and the comment event. Refuse this mutation and attach `:source-path` and `:diagnostic` to the refusal.

<details>

```diff

             [rheos.backend.domain.task-edit :as task-edit]
             [rheos.backend.infra.content-parser :as content-parser]
             [rheos.backend.infra.ledger :as ledger]
-            [rheos.backend.infra.watcher :as watcher]))
+            [rheos.backend.infra.watcher :as watcher]
+            [rheos.backend.law.frontmatter :as law-frontmatter]))
...
         raw (await (.readFile fsp task-path "utf8"))
         write-id (events/generate-write-id)
-        new-raw (-> (task-edit/plan-comment raw (content-parser/parse-task-content raw) text)
+        parsed (content-parser/parse-task-content raw)
+        _ (try
+            (law-frontmatter/assert-task-frontmatter-shape (:frontmatter parsed))
+            (catch :default err
+              (if (= :refused (:kind (ex-data err)))
+                (throw (ex-info (str "Refused card source " task-path ": " (.-message err))
+                                (assoc (ex-data err) :source-path task-path
+                                       :diagnostic (.-message err))
+                                err))
+                (throw err))))
+        new-raw (-> (task-edit/plan-comment raw parsed text)
                     (content-parser/inject-write-id write-id))
```
